coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 (translational subset). Window-of-opportunity trial; both registered arms are EXPERIMENTAL and receive troriluzole post-surgery, but Group B receives no presurgical troriluzole and serves as the comparison group for the presurgical tissue/ECoG endpoints, hence control_arm_from_other_arms = yes. Troriluzole is a prodrug of riluzole (formulation_flag prodrug); moiety kept as troriluzole since the INN is given. Glutamate and phospho-GluA2 coded candidate_matched as pharmacodynamic readouts of a glutamate-modulating drug (mechanism not explicitly stated in the record); these are pharmacodynamic rows only and do not affect selection. Pharmacodynamic markers are compared between arms rather than applied to one arm, so arms left empty.
